scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "GATEWAY,USER,PRODUK,TRANSAKSI" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run start:dev --prefix gateway" "npm run start:dev --prefix user" "npm run start:dev --prefix produk" "npm run start:dev --prefix transaksi"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "GATEWAY,USER,PRODUK,TRANSAKSI" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run start --prefix gateway" "npm run start --prefix user" "npm run start --prefix produk" "npm run start --prefix transaksi"
scripts.build: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,USER,PRODUK,TRANSAKSI" "npm run build --prefix gateway" "npm run build --prefix user" "npm run build --prefix produk" "npm run build --prefix transaksi"
